entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Before we play... I'd like to[n]talk to you about something.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: My mother told me that I should[n]lose my upcoming exhibition[n]match against the pro...
What do you mean?
I don't understand.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: It's a "strategy" she devised...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: She says that if I lose to a man,[n]I'll get sympathy from women, and[n]as a result get more female fans.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Then when I make my comeback, [n]I'll become a symbol for strong[n]women everywhere.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: That way, I can use the weekly [n]magazine's popularity against[n]them and instantly become famous.
That won't work.[clr 27]
That's a great strategy.
Do you intend to lose?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I wish I could agree, but...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I feel my mother may be right.[n]People do love a good comeback story.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Coming from the TV industry, [n]my mother does have great[n]insight for entertainment.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Yes... Almost frustratingly so.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Coming from the TV industry, [n]my mother does have great[n]insight for entertainment.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: And people love a good comeback story...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: By no means!

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: However, people do love a good[n]comeback story, especially in the[n]world of shogi...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: This time around... I couldn't help but[n]argue. It's the wrong thing to do...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I actually got into a fight with my[n]mother. It wasn't the first time, but...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: What made me sad was...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I realized my mother doesn't [n]see me as a shogi player...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: She said that there's no need [n]for me to be putting so much[n]time and effort into shogi...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...And that once I become [n]famous I can quit shogi and[n]make money from my looks.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: The only reason she continues to [n]support my shogi career is so she[n]can profit off of me as an idol.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: She doesn't mind if I lose a [n]match, as long as I build my[n]reputation and make money.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: To my mother, shogi is just [n]a vehicle to make me famous...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: However, losing on purpose is wrong!

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Even if it helped me to become famous[n]and eased my parents' burden...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I don't want to turn my back [n]on shogi... a game that both[n]my father and I love...
Let's make her reconsider.
Let's do something about it.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...If only that were possible.[n]She's the type of woman who[n]never changes her mind...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: She wants to achieve her [n]unfulfilled dream of becoming[n]a celebrity... through me.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I highly doubt she would ever reconsider...
What's your mother's name?
Tell me her name.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: It's... Mitsuyo Togo.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Whose name? My mother's? [n]It's... Mitsuyo. Mitsuyo Togo.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: What does that have to do with[n]what we're talking about...?
I need to do something [n]about the target for Hifumi...
